task: M. Heaven$ent social setup — FB Page + Instagram
resume_brief: Set up M. Heaven$ent social operation: (1) Instagram audit (profile, 10 posts, insights) → social/instagram-audit.md; (2) first-week content (7 IG posts + 5 FB drafts) → social/content/week1/; (3) Instagram DM inbox triage → social/instagram-inbox.md (categorize only, draft replies, don't send); (4) create 3 FB Page drafts via facebook-cli pages drafts create. Voice from social/VOICE-GUIDE.md and social/pages/m-heavensent.md on branch social/playbook-v1. No publishing, no DMs sent, no invented claims.
